primary_three_model_screen.interpretation: No verified target pool established by this conservative screen; not a proof that omissions are absent. Replacements, ambiguous alignments and uninspected positions remain outside this finding.

supplementary_pairwise_audit.selection: Exploratory secondary count on the same frozen18pages, not a new confirmatory endpoint

matched_budget_experiment.reason: Data gate did not establish a representative localized normal-output whole-line/region common-omission pool. Pairwise cases are old narrow superscript examples with a third cached recognizer already correct. Do not substitute them for a broad new-task validation.

limitations: This fixed batch was previously selected for citation studies, so its proportions are not prevalence estimates for scientific documents.
A shared image identifier does not verify identical historical resize, prompt, image bytes or postprocessing across public OCR caches.
The two markdown caches include cleaned outputs; their raw decode completion and postprocessing effects are unavailable.
All outputs passed a nonempty/nonrepetition proxy, but true normal termination cannot be established without finish metadata.
25of59short-symbol locations lack simultaneous unambiguous anchors; zero on34does not imply zero on59.
No new algorithm or recovery/error-rate improvement was evaluated.
blocking_evidence: No manually confirmed whole-line/region shared-omission population from this allowed existing-image/cache batch
Original completion and preprocessing provenance missing from historical caches
decision: STOP_AT_DATA_GATE; no GPU justification and no confirmation expansion
restart_conditions: First obtain a suitable fixed development batch with source-position labels and traceable normal-completion OCR outputs
Validate actual whole-line/region omissions or an explicitly separate short-symbol task with independent document groups

Before any fresh calls freeze equal call/pixel budget for ordinary detection+reread and confidence/consensus controls; only net recovery beyond strong controls at nonincreased harm can justify continuation
